site_tagline: A living library of written debates, organized by discipline.
read_resume_text: You had read {percent}% of this text.
footer_no_tracking: No trackers, no IP addresses kept.
landing_title: A living library of written debates
landing_lead: Long-form texts, linked by their arguments: refute, complement, prove. Under a pseudonym, with no email or account, no likes or followers.
landing_pillar_text_body: The basic unit is a developed text, versioned and kept over time.
landing_pillar_links_body: Every reply stays attached to what it refutes or complements. No popularity ranking.
landing_pillar_anon_body: Your identity is a key created in your browser. We collect nothing that could identify you.
report_terrorism_apology: Glorification of or incitement to terrorism
text_no_replies: No replies yet. Replies are written texts.
text_unsourced_hint: A “fact” text published without a source.
text_removed: Text removed on legal grounds. See the public removal log.
text_signed: Version signed by the author’s key
disciplines_lead: Search the texts, or browse the debates discussed most recently.
log_intro: Every moderation decision is reasoned and published here. The content is never reproduced.
author_moved: This pseudonym has moved to a new key.
id_intro: Your identity is a key created in your browser. We ask for no email, phone or password, and cannot recover it for you.
id_js_required: Creating a pseudonym and writing require JavaScript: the key is created and used in your browser. Reading works without it.
id_ephemeral: This browser’s storage is unavailable (Tor Browser, private browsing): your identity will only stay in memory until you close it. Import your phrase or key file each session.
id_words_warning: These 12 words are the only way to recover your pseudonyms on another device or after a loss. Write them on paper, in order, and keep them offline. No one can recover them for you.
id_confirm_intro: Enter the requested words to confirm your backup.
id_confirm_error: One or more words do not match.
id_import_invalid: Invalid phrase: check the words and their order.
id_name_hint: It will be followed by a unique fingerprint tied to your key, for example Hypatie#a3f9. It cannot be changed.
id_add_hint: Another pseudonym from the same phrase. Nothing public links them together.
id_backup_reminder: You have not yet confirmed the backup of your recovery phrase. Without it, losing this device is final.
id_protect_hint: The passphrase will be asked at each opening. It encrypts your identity on this device.
id_export_hint: Useful for Tor Browser or another device. The file is encrypted with a passphrase.
id_forget: Forget this identity on this device
id_forget_confirm: Without a saved recovery phrase, your pseudonyms will be lost for good. Continue?
id_need_identity: You need a pseudonym to write, reply or report.
act_withdraw_confirm: The body of every version will be erased; a trace will remain with its links. Continue?
act_report_intro: Disagreement is never a reason to report: reply with a text. Only report illegal content or content breaking the four rules.
act_report_sent: Report received. It will be reviewed by the legal referent.
ed_warnings_hint: The text will be collapsed until the reader chooses to show it.
ed_deferred_hint: The text will appear in one to three days, on a random date, so your pseudonyms cannot be linked by their publication dates.
ed_fact_hint: A “fact” text without a link to a source will be labelled “unsourced”.
ed_anonymous: No pseudonym yet: you will be asked for one when you sign. Until then your text stays on this device.
ed_sign_prompt: Your text is ready. To sign it you need a pseudonym: it is created in this browser, with no email or password. Your draft is kept on this device.
ed_draft_unavailable: This browser cannot keep a draft: do not close the page before publishing.
ed_draft_restored: Draft found, saved on this device.
ed_published_deferred: Text saved. It will appear on {date}.
ref_intro: Pending reports. Each decision is reasoned, signed with your key and published in the public log, without reproducing the content.
ref_forbidden: Your active pseudonym is not authorised.
ed_sources_hint: Add your references, then select a passage and cite the source: a note call will point to the reference.
ed_cite_hint: Select a word or phrase, then click “Cite”.
ed_math_hint: Write the formula in LaTeX: the preview updates as you type.
ed_timeline_hint: One event per line, as: date | title | description (optional).
ed_timeline_example: 1789 | Storming of the Bastille | Start of the Revolution
ed_timeline_error_missing_title: Line {line}: the title is missing (date | title).
ed_timeline_error_too_long: Line {line}: date, title or description is too long.
ed_diagram_hint: One relation per line: A -> B : label (optional). A lone name creates an element with no relation. Names contain neither "->" nor ":".
ed_diagram_example:
Premise -> Conclusion : therefore
Objection -> Premise : challenges
ed_diagram_error_empty_name: Line {line}: a name is missing before or after the arrow.
ed_diagram_error_forbidden: Line {line}: a name cannot contain "->" or ":" (one arrow per line).
ed_diagram_error_too_long: Line {line}: name or label is too long (80 characters at most).
ed_diagram_error_self_loop: Line {line}: an element cannot be related to itself.
ed_placeholder: Start writing. Tip: type "##" then a space for a heading, "-" for a list, ">" for a quote.
ed_help_start: At the start of a line (␣ = space)
ed_help_inline: In the text, wrap the passage
ed_help_table: In a table: Tab moves to the next cell, Shift+Tab to the previous one.
ed_help_break: Shift+Enter: line break within the same paragraph. Enter on an empty line: leave a list, a quote or a box.
ed_help_blocks: Tables, formulas, boxes, columns, timelines and diagrams: toolbar buttons; click a formula, timeline or diagram to edit it.
ed_title_placeholder: A clear title that states the thesis
ed_sources_empty: No sources yet. Add one to cite it in the text.
ed_translation_lang: A translation must be in a different language from the original.
q_intro: A question gathers contradictory positions on the same subject. Anyone can ask one or contribute a position with a text.
q_no_positions: No positions yet. Defend the first one with a text.
q_form_title_hint: Phrase it neutrally, without assuming the answer.
disc_intro: Refutations still unanswered, oldest first. No popularity ranking: only the structure of the debate counts.
snap_intro: Text copy of the source, made by the platform when it was cited, so it survives broken links. Formatting, images and scripts are not kept.
snap_hash: SHA-256 fingerprint of the downloaded content
snap_no_text: This type of content has no text version; only its fingerprint is kept.
jury_audit_intro: When a report goes to a jury, nine senior volunteer pseudonyms are drawn at random. The draw is verifiable: each day’s seed fingerprint is published in advance, the seed the next day. Each eligible pseudonym’s score is the SHA-256 of the seed, the report identifier and its key; the nine smallest are selected.
jury_audit_rules: Current rules: {size} jurors, minimum pool of {pool} volunteers, {age} days of seniority, {days} days to vote, two-thirds majority of votes cast, quorum of {quorum} votes.
jury_mine_intro: Jurors are drawn at random among volunteers whose pseudonym is at least {age} days old. You vote blind, on a legal criterion, with a short justification. Individual votes are never published.
jury_not_senior: Your pseudonym can be drawn from {date}.
jury_warning: The content below was reported as: {category}. It may be disturbing.
jury_question: Does this passage fall under the stated legal category?
rot_intro: If your recovery phrase may have been seen or stolen, replace it: a new phrase is created, and each of your pseudonyms is moved to a new key (signed by the old and the new). Your texts stay attached to your works; the old key can no longer publish.
rot_done: Your pseudonyms have been moved. Back up your new phrase.
qr_intro: Your identity is encrypted with a one-time code, then shown as a QR code. On the other device, choose “Receive from another device”, read the QR code (or paste the text) and enter the code.
qr_code: Code to enter on the other device
qr_scan: Read the QR code with the camera
qr_scan_unavailable: Camera reading is not available in this browser: paste the text shown on the other device.
ref_reporter_unreliable: Unreliable reporter: {dismissed} dismissed report(s) out of {closed}. No jury and no automatic masking.
ref_invitations_intro: Useful at launch when invitation-only sign-up is enabled. Only their fingerprint is kept, and nothing links a code to the pseudonym using it.
ref_invitations_once: Write them down now: they won’t be shown again.
appeal_intro: As the author, you can ask the legal referent to review this decision. Explain why you think it is unfounded.
appeal_sent: Appeal sent to the legal referent.
qreport_intro: A question should only be reported if its title or context is illegal. Disagreement is handled by defending another position.
qreport_sent: Report received. It will be reviewed by the legal referent.
id_invitation_hint: Sign-up is by invitation during launch. The code is not linked to your pseudonym.
read_controls_intro: These settings apply when reading texts. They stay in this browser.
prefs_intro: For each type of warning, choose how to display the affected content. This setting stays in this browser: no account, nothing is sent.
prefs_hidden_notice: Content hidden according to your reading preferences ({warnings}).
